title: Grateful Dead Live at Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V. on 1993-05-16
source: flac16/48kHz; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460/61 B18 > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Panasonic SV255 > DAT (OTS); Location: on the rail behind the soundboard dead center; Transfer info: Tascam DA 30 mkii > Microtrack ii > wavelab 5 > WAV 16/48

ai_review.summary: Decent Dan Healy stereo board mix with occasional patch and heat‑related quirks, but the show itself receives no specific praise or criticism.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that the recording captures a fairly solid 1993 soundboard stereo mix by Dan Healy after a tarp was removed, though early sections suffered from missing patches and extreme daytime heat. No particular songs or musical moments are highlighted, leaving the performance quality as essentially average.

ai_rating.rationale: The single 3‑star review balances modest praise for the stereo board mix against criticism of early sound issues, yielding an overall mixed assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo board mix with clear separation after tarp removal; some early patches missing and heat‑induced muffling noted. Reviewer contrasts this favorably against a later mono mix by Cutler.
